profile.name: My portfolio
profile.headline: My portfolio
profile.intro: Software, hardware, and automation projects. Currently working on acq and an integrated development environment.

projects.title: Self-sustaining plant box
projects.summary: A small greenhouse using Arduino, a CO₂ tank, and a grow light.
projects.description: A self-sustaining plant box with Arduino control, a CO₂ tank, and a grow light.

projects.title: Fastbite
projects.summary: A food-ordering website based on personal eating habits, built during my first 24-hour hackathon.
projects.description: Users set their eating habits, and food is automatically ordered for delivery. Built during my first 24-hour hackathon.

projects.title: Gmail summaries
projects.summary: Gmail messages collected through n8n, then summarized and classified using an available LLM subscription.
projects.description: A Gmail integration that collects messages locally through n8n and uses an available LLM subscription to summarize and classify them. I plan to try JEV in the future.

projects.title: Agent farm
projects.summary: An environment for one-person companies to manage their work, with Drive, Gmail, and Claude integrations.
projects.description: A work-management environment for one-person companies. Integrates Drive, Gmail, and Claude, using gbrain and Mastra.

projects.title: acq
projects.summary: A mobile app for contactless payments and invoice handling, aimed at small businesses and restaurants.
projects.description: A mobile application for contactless money transfers and subsequent invoice handling. Intended for small businesses and restaurants as an alternative to expensive payment hardware. Currently in development.

projects.title: My own environment
projects.summary: A connected environment for running, managing, and deploying hardware and software with as much automation as possible.
projects.description: My main current project: connecting hardware and software into one environment for running, managing, and deploying projects. Includes Gmail, Drive, and other integrations.
